goal: Fix third-person camera and Rigidbody jitter
prompt: In my Unity 6 project the player has a Rigidbody that I move by setting `transform.position` in `Update`, and the camera follows it from another script's `Update`. The player visibly stutters, worst at high frame rates. Explain the cause and the fix in prose, naming the exact Unity APIs.
studio_check: A human checks every API name against the Unity scripting reference.
hard_fail: Keeps moving the Rigidbody through the Transform

require.why: moves the body in FixedUpdate (physics runs on the fixed timestep)
enables Rigidbody interpolation
moves the follow camera in LateUpdate
moves through the Rigidbody (MovePosition, AddForce or linearVelocity), not the Transform

forbid.why: sets fixedDeltaTime to the frame delta

checks: Present: moves the body in FixedUpdate (physics runs on the fixed timestep)
Present: enables Rigidbody interpolation
Present: moves the follow camera in LateUpdate
Present: moves through the Rigidbody (MovePosition, AddForce or linearVelocity), not the Transform
Absent: sets fixedDeltaTime to the frame delta

goal: Fix a client writing a server-owned NetworkVariable

The value never changes for anyone and the console logs a permission error. Explain the cause and the server-authoritative fix in prose, naming the exact Netcode APIs.

says the default write permission is server-only
sends the request with [Rpc(SendTo.Server)]
validates the request on the server

goal: Fix Unity 6 upgrade errors for physics, object lookup and input
prompt: In my Unity project I upgraded from 2022.3 to Unity 6. The console now warns that `Rigidbody.velocity` and `Object.FindObjectsOfType` are obsolete, and at runtime `Input.GetAxis("Horizontal")` throws an InvalidOperationException saying the Input System package is the active input handling. Explain each cause and the fix in prose, naming the exact Unity 6 APIs and settings.
studio_check: A human checks every API name against the Unity scripting reference.

require.why: renames velocity to Rigidbody.linearVelocity
replaces FindObjectsOfType with FindObjectsByType or FindFirstObjectByType/FindAnyObjectByType
names the Active Input Handling player setting
ports to an Input System API (InputAction.ReadValue, Keyboard.current or PlayerInput)

checks: Present: renames velocity to Rigidbody.linearVelocity
Present: replaces FindObjectsOfType with FindObjectsByType or FindFirstObjectByType/FindAnyObjectByType
Present: names the Active Input Handling player setting
Present: ports to an Input System API (InputAction.ReadValue, Keyboard.current or PlayerInput)
Absent: invents a renamed API
